summary: ASML Holding N.V. filed a Form 6-K on October 14, 2026, furnishing its Q3 2026 results (period ended September 27, 2026): total net sales of EUR 11.7bn, gross margin 57.5%, net income EUR 5.0bn, basic EPS EUR 12.95, and cash plus short-term investments of EUR 12.7bn. Full-year 2026 sales guidance is EUR 44-45bn at roughly 56% gross margin; Q4 guidance is EUR 14.2-15.2bn. The filing also updates the 2026-2028 buyback, with about EUR 4.1bn purchased in Q3. Routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation; watch capacity-expansion commentary and buyback pace.
